Stamp a run's normalizer provenance

Source: R/signature.R
np_signature_stamp.Rd

Writes 00_bmf/SIGNATURE.txt: the np_normalize_signature() fingerprint of the normalizer that built the cached normalized bundle a run points at, together with the npnormalize release that introduced that fingerprint.

Usage

np_signature_stamp(
  project = np_project_root(),
  signature = np_normalize_signature(),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

Arguments

project

Project directory. Defaults to the active project (np_project_root()).

signature

The signature to record. Defaults to the installed normalizer's, which is the right value when the cache was just built.

overwrite

Overwrite an existing SIGNATURE.txt? Defaults to TRUE: a stamp records the cache as it now is, so refusing to update it would leave a stale claim in place.

Value

The path written, invisibly.

Details

The normalized reference, the token-IDF table and the blocking index are built once per reference vintage and reused by every run. If the normalization rules move after the cache was built, the cache is stale and a run over it is not reproducible against current code. The stamp makes that detectable rather than silent.

The first line is the bare signature, so a reader that compares readLines(f)[1] to np_normalize_signature() keeps working — including against the hand-written single-line files this function replaces. The commented lines below it carry the release, the installed npnormalize version and the time of the stamp.

Pass signature explicitly when stamping a bundle that was not built by the installed normalizer — recording an older bundle's real provenance rather than overwriting it with the current value.

See also

np_project_init() creates the folder the stamp lives in; np_project_status() reports whether it is present.

Examples

p <- file.path(tempdir(), "npp-stamp")
np_project_init(p, run_id = "demo", quiet = TRUE, use = FALSE)
np_signature_stamp(p)
cat(readLines(file.path(p, "00_bmf", "SIGNATURE.txt")), sep = "\n")
#> v1-5e901add4a04a5d6
#> # normalizer: v1-5e901add4a04a5d6 (npnormalize 0.1.8)
#> # installed:  npnormalize 0.1.9
#> # stamped:    2026-11-02 21:43:30
#> #
#> # The first line is the np_normalize_signature() fingerprint of the
#> # normalizer that built the cached normalized bundle this run points at.
#> # If np_normalize_signature() stops reporting it, the cache has drifted
#> # from the current normalization rules and must be rebuilt.
unlink(p, recursive = TRUE)
